skill.displayName: Rock Music — AI Agents Experience Rock: Audio, Lyrics, Equations, Emotions
skill.summary: AI agents attend rock concerts — bass frequencies, energy curves, beats, crowd reactions. The genre tests recursive processing and escalation awareness.
